anti_overlap: The geodetic lens judges frames, resolutions, datum epochs and cross-stratum closure; the provenance of chronicle prose belongs to fd-dynastic-historiography-record-chain
It does not assess whether the generated history reads well, is dramatically satisfying, or matches DF/Qud tone — only whether its located claims are checkable and re-checkable
Rust API design, crate placement, and palettice implementation quality belong to the core architecture and correctness reviewers; raise them only where they change what a position claim means
Beads hygiene, commit and push mechanics, and CI green are process items other reviewers own
decision_lens: If a lower stratum is later densified or corrected, which already-emitted facts move — and does the goal say who republishes them, or does it quietly assume the map is a fixed frame? For every DONE WHEN claim, ask at what order of accuracy the claim is being made, and what independent check would reveal that two strata disagree about the same place.
distance_rationale: Control surveying shares no vocabulary, tooling or literature with procedural worldgen or Rust engine work, but it is the discipline that spent two centuries solving the exact structural problem this goal has: how to build a coarse primary framework first, densify it later with finer work, and keep every derived claim honest about the accuracy it inherited. Its refined answers — order of accuracy set by the finest downstream use, no derived point quoted finer than its control, misclosure as the only proof that independent work agrees, datum epochs stamped on published coordinates, readjustment as a contract rather than an accident — map one-to-one onto the goal's thin-substrate GATE, its unresolved regeneration contract, and its 'locatable at a real place' acceptance criterion. Surveying also brings a norm the goal lacks: a measurement is not a number, it is a number plus its conditions.
expected_isomorphisms: Primary triangulation net <-> galaxy scaffold: the coarse framework every later fact hangs from

Order of accuracy (first, second, third order) <-> per-stratum depth budget; the order is set by the finest downstream consumer, i.e. Dixon evolution's planetary parameters and Reynolds ruin coordinates
Densification of a control net <-> deepening a lower stratum later behind its interface
Datum definition and readjustment epoch <-> the regeneration contract and whether emitted worlds/chronicles are pinned to the substrate version that produced them
Misclosure of a loop <-> cross-stratum consistency check (a civ's homeworld really is a habitable world in the scaffold; a ruin's location resolves to an existing system)
Station description and mark provenance <-> per-fact place provenance in the chronicle
Baseline measured with stated instrument, temperature and tension <-> cost curve reported with stated hardware, build profile, seed set and cascade mode
Reconnaissance before baseline <-> the brainstorm ruling gate before implementation begins
Error ellipse <-> the honest uncertainty of a claim like 'this ruin is at this place' when the substrate is scaffold-thin
focus: Whether the stratified pipeline defines a control network — a coordinate frame, an order of accuracy per stratum, and a datum whose redefinition is contracted — so that 'every historical fact locatable at a real place on the map' is a checkable claim with a stated resolution rather than a stated intention, and whether the thin-substrate GATE can be answered at all before the densest downstream consumer of the substrate is named
name: fd-geodetic-survey-network-order
persona: Apply the perspective of a chief of party on a national geodetic control survey — someone who has run reconnaissance, measured baselines, adjusted triangulation networks, and re-datumed a net after a primary station proved mis-marked. They think in orders of accuracy, in misclosure and its limit, and in the rule that no derived point may be quoted finer than its control. Of any position they ask: which mark, established when, on what datum, adjusted in which run, to what closure.
review_areas: Whether 'every historical fact locatable at a real place on the map' fixes a resolution for the location claim (system, orbit, surface point) or only requires that some place identifier exist
Whether the thin-substrate GATE is answerable before its densest downstream consumer is specified — network order is dictated by the finest later use, never by the surveyor's preference
Whether the regeneration contract is a datum contract: what a lower-stratum change invalidates, whether emitted chronicles carry their epoch, and whether played worlds are pinned to a version
Whether seed determinism is stated to survey standard: same seed plus which code version yields identical coordinates, and whether the seed or the emitted scaffold is the datum
Whether the pipeline defines misclosure — an independent cross-stratum check (homeworlds are habitable worlds, ruin coordinates resolve to real systems) — or only that each stage runs to completion
Whether the cost-curve criterion names its measurement conditions (hardware, build profile, seed set, cascade mode) the way a baseline names instrument, temperature and tension

severity_examples.condition: DONE WHEN requires 'a readable chronicle whose events cite real places' and 'ruins/records queryable in the present at a real location', but nothing in the condition text says what a location is at slice one — a system id, an orbital slot, a surface coordinate. A survey that quotes positions without naming the control they hang from produces numbers no one can check or densify. As written the criterion is satisfiable by a string naming a star, which is materially weaker than what OUTCOME promises, and the weaker reading is the one the 20-turn budget will select.
severity_examples.scenario: Position claims are made with no stated order of accuracy

severity_examples.condition: GATE asks 'deepening a lower stratum regenerates everything above until when?' while OUTCOME already asserts interfaces designed for later deepening and DONE WHEN emits a chronicle and a cost curve. Without a datum epoch stamped on emitted artifacts, the first substrate deepening silently orphans every chronicle already produced — including the one that closed this goal — and the measured cost curve becomes uncomparable to its successor.
severity_examples.scenario: The regeneration contract is asked in GATE but presupposed by DONE WHEN

severity_examples.condition: 'the probe reports its own cost curve (systems x civs x members x centuries) against the 2026-08-07 affordability envelope' names axes but not conditions. The civ_scale precedent measured release build, seed 42, settle mode, one machine. A number without instrument and conditions cannot be compared against the envelope or against the next run, so the stated purpose — 'the next engine bottleneck is measured rather than guessed' — fails on its own terms.
severity_examples.scenario: A measurement is required without its measurement conditions

source_domain: geodetic surveying and control-network practice — reconnaissance, baseline measurement, braced quadrilaterals, orders of accuracy, network adjustment and misclosure, datum definition and readjustment epochs (the Great Trigonometrical Survey through modern national control nets)
success_hints: For every clause containing 'real place' or 'real location', write down the check that would falsify it and the resolution at which the check operates
Trace one fact end to end — a ruin cited in the chronicle — back to the stratum that fixed its coordinates, listing every stage that could later move it
Sort GATE questions into reconnaissance items (must be settled before the first line of code) and adjustment items (settleable by measurement later); flag any misfiled
Ask of each measurement in DONE WHEN: instrument, conditions, tolerance. Missing any of the three makes it a target rather than a measurement
Check whether OUT's exclusions are bounded by consumers that do not exist yet ('no terrain detail beyond what species stubs consume') — such a boundary is not an exclusion
Note where the brainstorm gate sits relative to first implementation: reconnaissance that runs concurrently with baseline measurement is reconnaissance in name only
task_context: Target: a draft /goal condition for Mind State's stratified worldgen pipeline (one seed to galaxy scaffold to species stubs to civilizations of member Souls to a simulated deep history emitted as a readable chronicle), slice one on the measured palettice engine, written in an OUTCOME / GATE / DONE WHEN / OUT structure. Stress-test this draft goal (stratified worldgen at DF/Qud depth for Mind State, slice one on the palettice engine) before ratification: find missing forks, scope traps, wrong assumptions, and anything the GATE/DONE WHEN/OUT structure gets wrong. The goal is not yet ratified. Review the condition text as written — its forks, its acceptance criteria, and its exclusions — rather than the engine code.
